load_GENRE_model: load a pretrained GENRE entity linking model from a HuggingFace model name or local path
load_mGENRE_model: load a pretrained multilingual mGENRE model from a HuggingFace model name or local path
sample_entity_mentions: sample entity predictions for a list of sentences using beam search with configurable beams and return sequences
encode_sentence: encode a single sentence into a token ID tensor using the model's tokenizer
sample_with_marginalization: sample entity predictions and marginalize scores across multiple mentions using a text to ID mapping
